blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala dropped a hard-fought 7-5, 6-4 loss to Diana Shnaider in the round of 16 to conclude her campaign at the 2026 Ningbo Open in China. Eala saved several match points in the 10th game of the second set after falling behind 40-15, forcing Shnaider to work for every point in a grueling, deuce-filled endgame before the sixth-seeded Russian finally closed out the match in one hour, 55 minutes.
